        input=excluded_file.read_bytes(),
        capture_output=True,
        cwd=tmp_path,
        timeout=10,
    )
    
    # The output should be the unchanged content
    assert result.stdout == b"x = 1\n"

import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def test_changelog_heading_anchors() -> None:
    """
    Ensure that version headings in CHANGES.md produce stable anchor IDs
    (e.g., #version-2631) instead of auto-incremented ones (#id1, #id2, ...).
    """
    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    changes_path = repo_root / "CHANGES.md"
    assert changes_path.is_file(), f"{changes_path} not found"

    # Read the changelog
    changes_text = changes_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    # Find all h2 headings (## ...) that are version numbers (not "Unreleased")
    version_headings = re.findall(r"^##\s+(.+)$", changes_text, re.MULTILINE)
    version_headings = [h for h in version_headings if h != "Unreleased"]

    assert len(version_headings) > 0, "No version headings found in CHANGES.md"

    # Convert the changelog to HTML using commonmark (as the release scripts do)
    import commonmark

    html = commonmark.commonmark(changes_text)

    # Parse the HTML to find all h2 elements
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    h2_elements = soup.find_all("h2")

    # Collect the id attributes of all h2 elements that correspond to version headings
    version_ids = []
    for h2 in h2_elements:
        text = h2.get_text(strip=True)
        if text == "Unreleased":
            continue
        # The heading should have an id attribute
        h2_id = h2.get("id")
        assert h2_id is not None, f"h2 element for '{text}' has no id attribute"
        version_ids.append(h2_id)

    # Check that none of the ids are the generic auto-incremented pattern "idN"
    for vid in version_ids:
        assert not re.fullmatch(r"id\d+", vid), (
            f"Found auto-incremented anchor id '{vid}' instead of a stable one"
        )

    # Check that at least one id contains the version number (e.g., "version-2631")
    # This verifies the heading format produces meaningful anchors
    found_stable = False
    for heading, vid in zip(version_headings, version_ids):
        # The version string may contain dots; the anchor will have them removed
        version_stem = heading.replace(".", "")
        if version_stem.lower() in vid.lower():
            found_stable = True
            break
    assert found_stable, (
        "No version heading produced an anchor containing the version number. "
        "Expected stable anchors like 'version-2631'."
    )
